playbooks.title: Die-cut / behind-the-page BRIDGEt came back
playbooks.firesWhen: src/components/bridget-cutout.tsx or src/hooks/use-parallax.ts exists, or PageDieCut / diecut-stage appears in src/
playbooks.verify: npm run debt:strict exits 0. /bridget shows the locked bust in the clay orbit with no page hole.
playbooks.doneWhen: Those files are gone and no die-cut class or component remains.
steps: Delete src/components/bridget-cutout.tsx. Do not leave a stub export or a commented copy.
Delete src/hooks/use-parallax.ts if it returned with the cutout.
Search src/ for PageDieCut, diecut-stage, bridget-cutout, and mix-blend-mode used as a page hole. Remove every hit from site-shell, styles.css, and any route.
Keep BRIDGEt as the locked bust in BridgetOrbit via BRIDGET_AVATAR.figure (320×480). Do not add a white outline, statue-in-a-window, or behind-the-page frame.
Leave BrandSplash / IdentMark as the only first-load motion. Do not pair a cutout with a door overlay.
Run npm run debt:strict, then load /bridget and confirm the six clay items still surround her.

playbooks.title: Door page transition came back
playbooks.firesWhen: A DoorTransition symbol exists anywhere under src/
playbooks.verify: npm run debt:strict exits 0. Route changes are instant. Ident splash still plays once per tab session.
playbooks.doneWhen: DoorTransition is absent from src/ and no route-change overlay remains.
steps: Search src/ for DoorTransition. Remove the component, its import, and any <DoorTransition /> in site-shell or a layout.
Remove any door PNG/WebP overlay, clip-path doorway, or full-screen route wipe. Do not replace it with another transition.
Keep BrandSplash (INSUREitALL ident + ring pickup) as the only first-load motion. It uses sessionStorage key iia-ident-seen.
Confirm reduced-motion still skips the ident and that /bridget, /compare, and /contact paint without a wipe.
Run npm run debt:strict.

playbooks.title: Required legal or brand-lock file is missing
playbooks.firesWhen: privacy, terms, AI disclosure, accessibility, HIPAA proof, GLBA notice, bridget-assets.ts, or compliance.ts is gone
playbooks.verify: npm run debt:strict exits 0. Footer links 200 on /privacy, /hipaa, /glba, /terms, /ai-disclosure, /accessibility.
playbooks.doneWhen: Required legal files exist and the footer names Privacy, HIPAA & PHI, GLBA Privacy Notice, Terms, AI use, and Accessibility.
steps: Restore the missing file from git. Do not invent a one-line placeholder — copy the last good public page.
src/routes/privacy.tsx — public Privacy Policy. Keep NPN 20114179, Tampa address, TPMO/HIPAA language, and a section that links to /ai-disclosure.
src/routes/terms.tsx — public Terms. BRIDGEt is not a licensed agent and does not enroll. Phone-first contact stays (972) 525-2700.
src/routes/ai-disclosure.tsx — public AI-use page. State she is a non-licensed advocate, no PHI in the widget, no plan recommendations that bind a carrier.
src/routes/accessibility.tsx — public accessibility statement (WCAG 2.2 intent, how to request another format).
src/routes/hipaa.tsx — public HIPAA control map. Do not call it a certification. Keep the live product controls.
src/lib/hipaa.ts — control copy used by /hipaa. Keep it aligned with what the product actually does.
src/routes/glba.tsx — GLBA / NAIC 672 privacy notice. Sharing table must stay honest: no lead sales, no affiliate marketing.
src/lib/glba.ts — copy for /glba. Keep share rows aligned with actual practice.
src/lib/bridget-assets.ts — BRIDGET_AVATAR.figure, .bust, .mark must point at the locked public/brand/bridget files. Other components import this constant; do not hardcode paths.
src/lib/compliance.ts — TPMO, consent, and licensed-state copy. Footer and compare/screener pages depend on it.
Confirm SiteFooter still links Privacy, HIPAA & PHI, GLBA Privacy Notice, Terms, AI use, and Accessibility. Then npm run debt:strict.

src/routes/privacy.tsx: Restore src/routes/privacy.tsx from git (last good public Privacy Policy).
Keep NPN 20114179, 3550 Buschwood Park Dr Ste 180 Tampa FL 33618, and TPMO/HIPAA language.
Keep an AI / BRIDGEt section that links to /ai-disclosure.
Confirm the footer Privacy link hits this route, then npm run debt:strict.

State that INSUREitALL is a licensed agency (NPN 20114179) and BRIDGEt is not a licensed agent and does not enroll.

Link it from Privacy and from the footer as AI use.
src/routes/accessibility.tsx: Keep WCAG 2.2 intent, keyboard/focus notes, and how to request another format (phone or info@team-iia.com).
Confirm the footer Accessibility link hits this route, then npm run debt:strict.

This is the public control map, not a HIPAA certificate. Do not add a certified badge.
